summary.motive: Convert the 2-man structure into maximum pressure by walking a safety off the edge while the lone free safety swallows the entire deep zone by himself.
summary.keyDefender: SS blitzing off the edge — the scanning back is his only blocker and arrives a full second late
summary.whyItWorks: Press coverage underneath buys exactly the extra beat of time the fifth rusher needs, and the center-field safety removes all fear of a shot over the top.
summary.failureMode: An instant perimeter RPO thrown before the edge walker clears the tight end’s hinge block.

beats.title: 1. The Walked-Up Safety Tell
beats.text: The strong safety stands at 2 yards beside the tight end while the free safety roams completely alone at 13 — the five-man count is betrayed before the snap.

beats.title: 2. Five-Man Protection Math
beats.text: Five blockers must handle five rushers, and the only true blocker for the walking safety is a running back starting four yards away from the rim.

beats.title: 3. Hot Windows Pressed Shut
beats.text: Every quick answer is pressed underneath while the lone free safety removes any fear of a shot — the QB has nowhere to go with the ball early.

beats.title: 4. Free Runner Off the Rim
beats.text: The safety bends off the vacant tight-end spot into the escaping QB’s lap — five-man pressure cashing because coverage never had to help.

relations.tell: The strong safety stands at 2 yards beside the tight end while the free safety roams alone at 13 — base 2-man keeps both safeties splitting halves at 12.
